form:FormGroup.label: Model
form:FormGroup.helpText: The OpenAI-compatible model the stage calls.

form:FormGroup.label: Learning key
form:FormGroup.helpText: The fields a learned rule binds on and the model is shown, in order: Feed, Type, a receipt header such as Format or System, or Shape Signature. A shape is one value of this key. Feed and Type by default; add Shape Signature where one feed carries several kinds of record. A stream that lacks a value for a key field is not learned.

form:FormGroup.label: Relearn threshold (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: When a bound shape's rolling per-record score falls below this, the shape is relearned while its current rule keeps serving.

form:FormGroup.label: Allowed elements
form:FormGroup.helpText: Pipeline element types, one per line, that the model may choose between when asked which chain of elements fits. With a single entry the chain question is skipped.

form:FormGroup.label: Instructions
form:FormGroup.helpText: Free-text instructions added to every question put to the model.

form:FormGroup.label: Dialogue
form:FormGroup.helpText: The built-in dialogue this document starts from. Direct asks for the chain and then each element's configuration. Target first settles the record boundary, asks what one record of each kind should become, and holds every configuration to those events; more questions, and the schema is learned on the cheaper one.

form:FormGroup.label: Dialogue steps
form:FormGroup.helpText: The questions asked, one per line, in order; empty for the dialogue's own. A line is a kind — CHAIN, SPLIT, TARGET or CONFIGURE — then optionally 'when text', 'when xml' or 'when always', 'candidates N' (the maximum candidates when unset) and, for TARGET, 'kinds N' (how many kinds of record are asked about). CHAIN must come first and CONFIGURE last; SPLIT and TARGET at most once each between them.

form:FormGroup.label: Question text
form:FormGroup.helpText: The words of each question, editable. The text shown is what this document uses: the built-in text, or this document's own where it has been changed. A variable written as a dollar sign and a name in braces is filled in when the question is put; each text names the variables it may use in the built-in. 'Use built-in' drops this document's change.

form:FormGroup.label: Maximum candidates
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many candidate chains an attempt may try, re-asking the failing element with feedback, before the shape is given up on.

form:FormGroup.label: Attempt budget (ms)
form:FormGroup.helpText: Wall-clock budget for a whole attempt, every question included. Mandatory; there is no unlimited setting.

form:FormGroup.label: Token budget
form:FormGroup.helpText: Token budget for a whole attempt. Zero means unlimited.

form:FormGroup.label: Sample redaction
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the samples and headers sent to the model are reduced to token classes or sent as they are.

form:FormGroup.label: Sample size limit (bytes)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The largest sample sent to the model.
